AddEntry(Collider, int)

Adds a new entry for the specified collider to the register or resets an existing entry. If the collider was already added this frame, returns null. Otherwise, returns a cleared or new HashSet<T> with the specified capacity.

public HashSet<T>? AddEntry(Collider collider, int capacity)

Parameters

collider Collider

The collider to add or reset in the register.

capacity int

The initial capacity for the associated HashSet<T>.

Returns

HashSet<T>

The HashSet<T> associated with the collider, or null if the collider was already added this frame.

Clean()

Cleans up the register by removing colliders that were not used in the current frame, and prepares the register for the next frame by marking all remaining colliders as unused.

public void Clean()

Close()

Clears all entries from the register and unused colliders, effectively closing and resetting the register.

public void Close()

TryGetEntry(Collider, out HashSet<T>?)
